compatibility_changes: HyperFrames v0.8.31 adds lint detection for video or image sources that point to audio files. reCast does not currently expose HyperFrames-compatible lint or check commands, so no unsupported CLI surface was added.

HyperFrames v0.8.31 streams Studio preview media byte ranges rather than reading entire media files and includes related Windows stream bridging and atomic waveform-cache publication. reCast's browser-hosted Studio does not run the corresponding local Studio preview server or waveform-cache architecture, so no equivalent implementation change is required for an exposed compatibility interface.

HyperFrames v0.8.31 refines lint/check diagnostics for grouped animation staging, displayed code, overlap/occlusion deduplication, partial motion specifications, and checked project descriptors. These are internal diagnostic semantics outside reCast's currently exposed independent interfaces.
The compatibility implementation mirrors documented behavior and interfaces only; no upstream implementation code is copied.
policy: Track documented behavior and compatibility surfaces; do not copy upstream implementation code.
